question.text:
The total number of reagents from those given below, that can convert nitrobenzene into aniline is __________ . (Integer answer)
I. Sn-HCl
II. Sn-NH4OH
III. Fe-HCl
IV. Zn-HCl
V. H2-Pd
VI. H2- Raney Nickel

solution.text: Nitrobenzene converted into Aniline by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>-</mo><mi>Sn</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>HCl</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>Fe</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>HCl</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>/</mo><mi>Pd</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>/</mo></math> Raney <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Ni</mi><mo>.</mo></math>
